info.title: Qapital API
info.description: Quantum-assisted portfolio optimisation (QAOA), benchmarked honestly against classical methods.

get.description: Live progress: a `progress` event on every change, then one `done`, `error` or `cancelled` event.

Allocation.title: Allocation
Allocation.description: The chosen stocks turned into whole shares for the investor's money and holdings.

tickers.title: Tickers
tickers.description: Stocks to choose from; empty means the whole market

include_quantum.title: Include Quantum
include_quantum.description: Also run QAOA at every rebalance (slow)

BacktestRequest.title: BacktestRequest
BacktestRequest.description: POST /backtest: replay the strategy through history, rebalancing with only the data known at the time.

Correlations.title: Correlations
Correlations.description: GET /markets/{id}/correlations: how each pair of stocks moved together, grouped by sector.

CostInfo.title: CostInfo
CostInfo.description: How trading costs entered the score.

DataStatus.title: DataStatus
DataStatus.description: GET /data/status: which price snapshot is in use, and how good its data is.

Estimation.title: Estimation
Estimation.description: How the expected returns and risks were estimated.

HardwareCheck.title: HardwareCheck
HardwareCheck.description: A tuned circuit run on IBM hardware (or a fake chip in Runtime's local mode), graded like a noisy run.

HardwareRequest.title: HardwareRequest
HardwareRequest.description: POST /admin/hardware: run a small tuned circuit on IBM hardware (or a fake chip with "fake:<name>").

Market.title: Market
Market.description: GET /markets: one stock market the website can optimise over.

NoiseComparison.title: NoiseComparison
NoiseComparison.description:
Same quality numbers on the perfect simulator and the fake IBM chip.
`postselected_*` grade only the noisy shots that hold exactly K stocks; `postselected_share` is how many did.
`mitigated_*` (when readout mitigation is on) undo the measured readout errors first; `readout_error` is the
average chance a qubit was misread in calibration.

Optimal.title: Optimal
Optimal.description: What is known about the best portfolio, so every method can be judged against it.

tickers.title: Tickers
tickers.description: Stocks to choose from; empty means the whole market

cash.title: Cash
cash.description: Money to invest, in the market's currency

window_years.title: Window Years
window_years.description: Years of past prices used for the estimates

horizon_years.title: Horizon Years
horizon_years.description: How long the portfolio is meant to be held

as_of.title: As Of
as_of.description: Use only prices up to this date (YYYY-MM-DD); default: latest

PruningRow.title: PruningRow
PruningRow.description:
qapital.core.schemas.PruningPoint as the website receives it:
lift over random legal guessing at each level of pruning.

mixer.title: Mixer
mixer.description: standard (penalty), xy (keeps K; ours), warm (penalty started from the relaxed solution)

cvar_alpha.title: Cvar Alpha
cvar_alpha.description: Tune for the best α-fraction of outcomes (CVaR); 1 = the plain average

mitigate_readout.title: Mitigate Readout
mitigate_readout.description: On noisy runs, measure and undo readout errors

Settings.title: Settings
Settings.description: What the user chose on the website.

StartQuality.title: StartQuality
StartQuality.description: What a circuit's starting state alone gives, before any quantum layer (exact chances).
